D.question: ¿Cuántos metros cúbicos de petróleo producidos en 2025 le corresponden a YPF según su participación, es decir, sumando en cada concesión la producción de petróleo multiplicada por el porcentaje de YPF en esa concesión?

attempts.query:
with ypf as (
  select empresa_id from energia.empresa where nombre ~* '^\s*YPF(\s+S\.?\s*A\.?)?\s*$'
), prod as (
  select id_concesion, sum(petroleo_m3) as pet from energia.produccion_pozo group by id_concesion
)
select sum(p.pet * pa.porcentaje / 100.0) as petroleo_ypf_m3
from prod p
join energia.participacion pa on pa.id_concesion = p.id_concesion
where pa.empresa_id in (select empresa_id from ypf)

e03.question: ¿Cuáles son las 5 concesiones con más posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024, contando los puntos que caen dentro del contorno de cada concesión?

B.question: ¿Cuáles son las 5 concesiones con más posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024, contando los puntos que caen dentro del contorno de cada concesión?

attempts.query:
with pts as (
  select c.id_concesion, c.areapermisoconcesion, (p.value->>0)::float8 as x, (p.value->>1)::float8 as y, p.ord
  from sig_energia.concesion c,
       jsonb_array_elements(c.anillo::jsonb) with ordinality as p(value, ord)
  where c.anillo is not null and jsonb_typeof(p.value->0) = 'number'
),
edges as (
  select id_concesion, areapermisoconcesion, x as x1, y as y1,
         coalesce(lead(x) over w, first_value(x) over w) as x2,
         coalesce(lead(y) over w, first_value(y) over w) as y2
  from pts
  window w as (partition by id_concesion order by ord)
),
bbox as (
  select id_concesion, min(x1) minx, max(x1) maxx, min(y1) miny, max(y1) maxy
  from edges group by id_concesion
),
cand as (
  select b.id_concesion, v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat
  from bbox b join sig_energia.venteo_detectado v
    on v.lon between b.minx and b.maxx and v.lat between b.miny and b.maxy
  where v.fecha >= date '2024-01-01'
),
inside as (
  select c.id_concesion, c.gml_id
  from cand c join edges e on e.id_concesion = c.id_concesion
  where (e.y1 > c.lat) <> (e.y2 > c.lat)
    and c.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (c.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  group by c.id_concesion, c.gml_id
  having count(*) % 2 = 1
)
select max(e.areapermisoconcesion) as concesion
from inside i join (select distinct id_concesion, areapermisoconcesion from edges) e on e.id_concesion = i.id_concesion
group by i.id_concesion
order by count(distinct i.gml_id) desc
limit 5

B.question: ¿Cuántas concesiones tienen al menos un posible venteo detectado por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024 dentro de su contorno y tienen el gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS más cercano a 10 km o más de su contorno?

WITH c AS (
  SELECT id_concesion,
         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(anillo::jsonb->0->0)='array' THEN anillo::jsonb->0 ELSE anillo::jsonb END AS ring
  FROM sig_energia.concesion WHERE anillo IS NOT NULL AND anillo <> ''
),
cv AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, ord, (p->>0)::float8 AS x, (p->>1)::float8 AS y
  FROM c, jsonb_array_elements(ring) WITH ORDINALITY t(p, ord)
),
ce AS (
  SELECT a.id_concesion, a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2
  FROM cv a JOIN cv b ON a.id_concesion=b.id_concesion AND b.ord=a.ord+1
),
bb AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM cv GROUP BY id_concesion
),
v AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'
),
con_venteo AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT bb.id_concesion, v.gml_id
    FROM v JOIN bb ON v.lon BETWEEN bb.minx AND bb.maxx AND v.lat BETWEEN bb.miny AND bb.maxy
    JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion=bb.id_concesion
    WHERE (ce.y1 > v.lat) <> (ce.y2 > v.lat)
      AND v.lon < (ce.x2-ce.x1)*(v.lat-ce.y1)/(ce.y2-ce.y1)+ce.x1
    GROUP BY bb.id_concesion, v.gml_id
    HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
  ) s
),
gl AS (
  SELECT g.gml_id, l.lord, l.line
  FROM enargas.gasoducto g,
       jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(g.lineas::jsonb->0->0)='array' THEN g.lineas::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array(g.lineas::jsonb) END) WITH ORDINALITY l(line, lord)
  WHERE g.lineas IS NOT NULL AND g.lineas <> ''
),
gv AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lord, ord, (p->>0)::float8 x, (p->>1)::float8 y
  FROM gl, jsonb_array_elements(line) WITH ORDINALITY t(p, ord)
),
ge AS (
  SELECT a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2
  FROM gv a JOIN gv b ON a.gml_id=b.gml_id AND a.lord=b.lord AND b.ord=a.ord+1
),
-- distancia punto-segmento en km (proyección equirectangular local)
d1 AS ( -- vértices de gasoducto contra bordes de concesión
  SELECT ce.id_concesion, gv.x px, gv.y py, ce.x1, ce.y1, ce.x2, ce.y2
  FROM gv JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM con_venteo)
),
d2 AS ( -- vértices de concesión contra segmentos de gasoducto
  SELECT cv.id_concesion, cv.x px, cv.y py, ge.x1, ge.y1, ge.x2, ge.y2
  FROM cv JOIN ge ON true WHERE cv.id_concesion IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM con_venteo)
),
dd AS (SELECT * FROM d1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM d2),
dk AS (
  SELECT id_concesion,
    (px-x1)*111.32*cos(radians(py)) ax, (py-y1)*110.574 ay,
    (x2-x1)*111.32*cos(radians(py)) bx, (y2-y1)*110.574 by_
  FROM dd
),
dist AS (
  SELECT id_concesion,
    min(sqrt(power(ax - bx*t, 2) + power(ay - by_*t, 2))) dmin
  FROM (

gas_dentro AS ( -- algún vértice de gasoducto dentro del contorno

)
SELECT count(*) FROM con_venteo cvt
JOIN dist ON dist.id_concesion = cvt.id_concesion
WHERE dist.dmin >= 10
